ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes fájlokat es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód nem lehet trancutted nem lehet olyan hogy …és hasonlóan 50 xy nem lehet dummy to do sorry hiányosság minden fájl teljes kódját egyesével fájkba írod semmi mást nem írsz ezen kívűl Construct a complete, production-ready, serverless multimodal inference engine deployed on Modal (modal.com). The system must serve a hybrid linear-attention/full-attention Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision-language foundation model supporting a full 262,144-token context window, maximal output token generation, and concurrent high-resolution image/video inputs. 

Do not use high-latency initialization loops, unquantized baseline forward passes, or runtime weight transfers. Implement custom high-throughput CUDA/Triton kernels for block-wise FP8 computation, hybrid memory-mapped weight streaming from Modal Volumes with flash-boot snapshots, and an interleaved speculative decoding verifier.

Deliver all source files in full, unabridged code without placeholders, stubs, ellipses, or simulated routines.

### System Architecture and Model Specifications

1. Core Text Backbone Configuration:
   - Context window: 262,144 tokens (`max_position_embeddings: 262144`).
   - Vocabulary size: 248,320 tokens (`vocab_size: 248320`, `bos_token_id: 248044`, `eos_token_id: 248044`).
   - Dimensions: Hidden size 2,560, 48 hidden layers (`num_hidden_layers: 48`).
   - Layer Pattern: Interleaved repeating structure where every 4th layer is Full Attention (`full_attention_interval: 4`), and all other 3 intervening layers are Linear Attention (State-Space / Linear Conv).
   - Linear Attention Specifications: Convolution kernel dimension 4 (`linear_conv_kernel_dim: 4`), key head dimension 128 (`linear_key_head_dim: 128`), value head dimension 128 (`linear_value_head_dim: 128`), 16 key heads (`linear_num_key_heads: 16`), and 48 value heads (`linear_num_value_heads: 48`).
   - Full Attention Specifications: 24 attention heads (`num_attention_heads: 24`, `head_dim: 256`), 2 key-value heads (`num_key_value_heads: 2`), sparse indexer routing budget 2,048 (`indexer_budget: 2048`, `indexer_compress_ratio: 4`, `indexer_head_dim: 128`, `indexer_n_heads: 4`, `indexer_kv_heads: 1`).
   - Rotary Embeddings: Multimodal Interleaved RoPE (mRoPE) partitioned across 3 sections [11, 11, 10] (`mrope_section: [11, 11, 10]`), partial rotary factor 0.25 (`partial_rotary_factor: 0.25`), base theta 10,000,000.0 (`rope_theta: 10000000.0`).
   - HyperConnection Mixer: Residual stream hyperconnections with rank-320 bottleneck (`hc_count: 4`, `hc_lowrank: 320`) per attention and MLP block with `input_mix_weight_down`, `input_mix_weight_up`, and `block_inject_weight`.
   - Prior Layer Enhancement (PLE): Conv1D kernel size 4 and embedding dimension 2,560 on designated layers (`ple_layer_ids: [2]`).
   - Mixture of Experts (MoE): 512 total routed experts (`num_experts: 512`), 10 active experts per token (`num_experts_per_tok: 10`), routed intermediate size 640 (`moe_intermediate_size: 640`), plus 1 dedicated shared expert (`shared_expert_intermediate_size: 640`) with sigmoid gating.
   - Multi-Token Prediction (MTP): 1-layer hybrid speculative draft module with projection matrices (`mtp_num_hidden_layers: 1`, `ngram_size: 3`) verifying speculative n-grams in parallel.

2. Multimodal Vision Encoder Configuration:
   - Vision Transformer: 27 depth layers (`depth: 27`), hidden dimension 1,152 (`hidden_size: 1152`), 16 attention heads (`num_heads: 16`), MLP intermediate dimension 4,304 (`intermediate_size: 4304`), `gelu_pytorch_tanh` activation.
   - Spatial/Temporal Merging: Patch size 16x16 (`patch_size: 16`), temporal patch size 2 (`temporal_patch_size: 2`), 2D spatial merge size 2x2 (`spatial_mergesize: 2`), projected to text hidden dimension 2,560 (`out_hidden_size: 2560`).
   - Special Token Delimiters: `vision_start_token_id: 248053`, `vision_end_token_id: 248054`, `image_token_id: 248056`, `video_token_id: 248057`.

3. Quantization and Memory Layout:
   - Quantization Format: Block-wise FP8 (`quant_method: fp8`, `weight_block_size: [128, 128]`, dynamic activation scaling).
   - Precision Exceptions: Normalization layers, embeddings (`embed_tokens`), hyperconnection mixers, PLE convolutions, and linear attention 1D convolutions remain in float32 / bfloat16.

### Infrastructure, Cold-Start, and GPU Strategy

1. GPU Allocation and Cost Efficiency:
   - Target Hardware: Deploy on a multi-GPU configuration (such as 2x or 4x NVIDIA L40S 48GB or NVIDIA A100/H100 NVLink) optimized to maintain the entire 512-expert FP8 parameter set and dynamic KV-cache across 262,144 positions without out-of-memory errors while minimizing hourly execution cost.
   - Cold-Start Elimination: Persist weights in a high-speed Modal Volume with sequential chunk indexing. Pre-compile Triton kernels during image build (`modal.Image.dockerfile_commands` / `run_function`). Utilize Modal snapshotting and memory-mapped direct CUDA allocation (`torch.UntypedStorage.from_file`) to bypass CPU-to-GPU transfer bottlenecks.

2. Serving Engine Architecture:
   - Paged Attention and State-Space Ring Buffer: Paged KV-cache manager for Full Attention layers and fixed-size circular state buffers for Linear Attention layers.
   - Continuous Batching and Scheduling: Radix-tree prefix cache reuse for shared prompt prefixes and vision token sequences.
   - Async Web Server: FastAPI server providing OpenAI-compatible endpoints (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/models`) supporting Server-Sent Events (SSE) token streaming, multi-image base64 decoding, and video frame tensor batching.

### Required Source Files and Implementation Deliverables

Implement the complete codebase across the following structured files:

- `engine/config.py`: Complete dataclass configurations matching the exact parameters for text backbone, vision encoder, MoE routing, MTP speculative head, and FP8 block quantization.
- `engine/kernels.py`: Custom Triton kernels for block-wise FP8 matrix multiplication (`[128, 128]` tile scaling), mRoPE interleaved position application, and fused linear-attention causal 1D conv + state-space step.
- `engine/vision.py`: Vision Transformer implementation supporting dynamic image resolution grid partitioning, 3D video temporal-patch extraction, 2D merge projection, and multimodal token interleaving.
- `engine/model.py`: Neural network implementation containing HyperConnection mixers, PLE blocks, 512-expert Top-10 MoE sparse router with shared expert fusion, 48-layer hybrid attention backbone, and MTP speculative decoding head.
- `engine/kv_cache.py`: Hybrid Paged KV-cache manager supporting 256k-token contexts, dynamic page allocation, and Linear Attention recurrent state buffers.
- `engine/sampler.py`: Speculative MTP tree-verification sampler and continuous batching scheduler.
- `app.py`: Modal application script defining `modal.App`, custom container image dependencies, Volume mounts, memory-mapped prewarming, container lifecycle methods (`@app.cls`), and streaming FastAPI endpoints.
- `client.py`: End-to-end client script demonstrating multimodal inference requests containing text, ultra-high-resolution images, and video clips up to full context limits.

Ensure all tensor operations adhere strictly to PyTorch and Triton standards with correct dimension broadcasting, tensor parallelism hooks, dynamic FP8 scaling math, and strict input validation.
